metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds her decision to go, the opening, the tomb in the dusk, the reckoning, the moon from the gate, and the door.

yesterday: She sat in the lower gallery in her church hat, with Alse beside her.
The light came when he said light. The death stayed five words.
Twelve pound thirteen in the boxes, and forty shillings the share. Heminges said both figures and would not divide them.
At the door the whole of it was good night. The forty shillings is what you brought home.
